code-and-seeds.md 的示例写 import { engineer } from '../../seed-data/permission-sets.js'，而同一段结尾说明该文件是 database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts。迁移/种子由 task-loader 以原生 import 加载，__rewriteRelativeImportExtension 只把源码中的 .ts/.tsx 说明符改写为 .js，并不存在把 .js 说明符解析回 .ts 的机制，因此照抄示例会在安装时抛 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND。

评审时 · 文档 / API 声称

指引把 .js 说明符作为可复制的种子写法，并同时称目标文件是 .ts。

评审时 · 实际观察

迁移/种子任务加载器（task-loader.js）仅改写 .ts→.js，无反向解析；应用最初照抄该示例，安装报 “Cannot find module .../database/seed-data/permission-sets.js”，改为 .ts 后才通过。

实际影响
Agent 按官方示例生成的安装种子在 Node 原生 TS 运行时会直接启动失败，且错误信息指向示例本身，排查成本高。

code-and-seeds.md 的种子示例 import { engineer } from '../../seed-data/permission-sets.js'（第 69 行）指向一个 .ts 文件，而同一段结尾（第 97 行）又称该文件为 database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts，存在自相矛盾的模块扩展名。

## A normal App seed has a database context

`defineSeed` from `@nocobase/db` receives `{ query, connection }`. `connection` is a restricted `SeedConnection`, not a complete runtime `DatabaseConnection`; the seed has no application container. Do not cast it to construct an App authorization service or assume `authorizationToken` can be resolved there.

For initial installation, a seed may write the documented persistence rows below after the owning plugins' migrations. Keep this adapter confined to installation data, use fluent values as its input, and test against the installed schema. Runtime routes must use the services instead. Keep one seed-data module per table.

```ts
import { defineSeed } from '@nocobase/db';
import { encodeAuthorizationTitle } from '@nocobase/authorization/core';
import { engineer } from '../../seed-data/permission-sets.js';

export default defineSeed({
  name: '202609190001_sales_jobs',
  transaction: true,
  async run({ query }) {
    const existing = await query
      .selectFrom('authorizationPermissionSets')
      .select('id')
      .where('key', '=', engineer.key)
      .executeTakeFirst();
    if (existing) return; // Preserve an administrator's existing definition.
    const now = new Date();
    await query
      .insertInto('authorizationPermissionSets')
      .values({
        id: engineer.key,
        key: engineer.key,
        title: encodeAuthorizationTitle(engineer.title),
        grants: JSON.stringify(engineer.grants),
        createdAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
      })
      .execute();
  },
});
```

This seed lives in `database/main/seeds/202609190001_sales_jobs.ts` and imports `database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts`. Adapt the path to the App's configured seed directory; the seed name matches the filename. Ensure schema migrations for authorization and business collections have run, and explicitly order prerequisite installation data. Use the App's existing migration/seed commands. Do not run this code in a migration: migrations must describe fixed schema history and cannot import live business declarations.

var __rewriteRelativeImportExtension = (this && this.__rewriteRelativeImportExtension) || function (path, preserveJsx) {
    if (typeof path === "string" && /^\.\.?\//.test(path)) {
        return path.replace(/\.(tsx)$|((?:\.d)?)((?:\.[^./]+?)?)\.([cm]?)ts$/i, function (m, tsx, d, ext, cm) {
            return tsx ? preserveJsx ? ".jsx" : ".js" : d && (!ext || !cm) ? m : (d + ext + "." + cm.toLowerCase() + "js");
        });
    }
    return path;
};

app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/runtime-api.md:98–118E10

runtime-api.md 说明集合/复合资源“In the owning provider's boot method”注册，并在同页示例中使用 router.use('*', authentication.required(), authz.middleware()) 作为服务端强制授权写法。

// In the owning provider's boot method:
authz.database.collections.add({ name: 'quotes', title: 'Quotes' });
authz.database.collections.add({ name: 'projects', title: 'Projects' });
const reference = authz.compositeResources.define(quotes);
authz.ui.sections.add({ name: 'sales', title: 'Sales', parent: 'business' });
authz.ui.place(reference, { section: 'sales' });
```

Every collection a business action touches must be registered, including for unrestricted users. Registration carries `name`, `title`, optional `description` and `actions` (default `read`, `create`, `update`, `delete`); field, primary-key and relation metadata comes from the database. Re-adding a collection with the same actions is a no-op, even with a different title or description: the first registration is kept and startup logs a warning. Different actions throw. Pages are not registered here: the client route that declares `authz: { resource: { type: 'page', id: 'sales.quotes' }, action: 'access' }` is what lists the page in the workspace.

`.grant(key, permission, { title? })` binds a collection permission to a data scope named `key`. Read fields govern output; create and update fields govern input. Use explicit lists, `'*'` or `.allFields()`; delete has no fields. Include fields written by the server, such as timestamps. `.options(...recordAccessReferences)` limits the record access a grant may choose; `.default(reference)` sets the value used when a grant chooses nothing. Omitting options offers every registered record access that applies to the collection.

Use [code versus seeds](code-and-seeds.md) for the engineer permission set and its assignments, and [record access](business-module.md#3-register-record-access) for the preparer and region selections. Page access and business actions are independent; registration alone grants neither.

## Enforce the operation on the server

Every route installs authentication and `authz.middleware()`. For a business action, authorize once and bind every resulting collection policy before executing queries. Validate input and business transitions separately.

```ts
router.use('*', authentication.required(), authz.middleware());
router.get('/quotes', async (c) => {
app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/server-routes.md:110–120E22

server-routes.md 明确警告“A router.use('*', ...) on the top-level router leaks into contributions mounted later”，并把中间件限定到自有路径或独立子路由器。

Keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and its static policies. For business authorization, follow the installed authorization Skill’s `references/repository-routes.md`: `authz.database.authorizeRepository({ repository, resource, actions })` binds Repository methods to typed business actions and narrows the existing policy through middleware. Authenticate first and cover every action of the protected exposure. Use the shortcut when one Repository operation and one data scope complete the action with standard input/output; independent type/length validation can remain middleware. Persisted-state checks, side effects, multiple scopes and enriched responses require custom handlers: project title/notes editing fits the shortcut, while draft quote editing, quote submission and order delivery do not. One resource can use both styles for different actions. Do not substitute collection-aggregated grants for a business-action decision.

Static endpoint policies only narrow user grants. Read/write relation capabilities must be explicitly granted; a relation in the static shape does not create permission. Use the authorization Skill's `references/business-module.md` for the full workflow and `references/fluent-registration.md` for field/relation declarations. The installable authorization example demonstrates quote submission and delivery responsibilities.

## Scope middleware to paths you own

Use the explicit path, or an isolated sub-router mounted at your prefix as above. A `router.use('*', ...)` on the top-level router leaks into contributions mounted later and is the way an unrelated endpoint accidentally becomes protected — or, worse, the way yours accidentally is not.

## Deliberately public routes

A third-party webhook cannot present a login session, so it is public by design. Public still requires a security boundary:
app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/repository-routes.md:166–172E54

repository-routes.md 的“Enforcement and limits”称 “Using '*' is appropriate inside an isolated, owned router: the middleware ignores other repository names”，与 server-routes.md 对顶层 router.use('*') 泄漏的警告形成对照。

## Enforcement and limits

- Mount the middleware on every action of the named exposure. Using `'*'` is appropriate inside an isolated, owned router: the middleware ignores other repository names. A method of its repository with no mapping is denied, including methods added to the generated route later.
- The middleware reuses the request's existing authorization context or initializes one. Authentication is still the owning route's responsibility.
- Each bound action must declare exactly one data scope, compose grants on that collection only and contain the mapped CRUD operation. Multi-collection or same-collection multi-scope actions are rejected at integration time. Resource registration must precede router creation.
- One composite can be bound to several Repository exposures through separate middleware instances. Each mapping is checked at the action level. An exposure's actual collection and database connection must match the request constraint; this adapter currently supports the default connection only.
- Keep actions requiring workflow state, cross-record relationships, or side effects in custom handlers. Single-scope authorization does not prove that an operation needs no business validation. Quote editing/submission and delivery remain custom in the sales workflow.
app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/repository-routes.md:43–49E12

repository-routes.md 的示例声明 view 用 read 字段、edit 用“read plus update”字段，是文档中少数提示写权限需同时声明 read 字段的地方。

      .action('edit', (action) =>
        action.grant('projects', projectData.update(['title', 'notes'])),
      ),
);
```

The project resource declares `view` with project read fields and `edit` with read plus update of `title` and `notes`, both under one `projects` scope. The following route module imports that application-owned declaration. The route factory owns authentication and the body limit; register its exported contribution in the App's server routes.

runtime-api.md 说明集合/复合资源“In the owning provider's boot method”注册，并在同页示例中使用 router.use('*', authentication.required(), authz.middleware()) 作为服务端强制授权写法。

// In the owning provider's boot method:
authz.database.collections.add({ name: 'quotes', title: 'Quotes' });
authz.database.collections.add({ name: 'projects', title: 'Projects' });
const reference = authz.compositeResources.define(quotes);
authz.ui.sections.add({ name: 'sales', title: 'Sales', parent: 'business' });
authz.ui.place(reference, { section: 'sales' });
```

Every collection a business action touches must be registered, including for unrestricted users. Registration carries `name`, `title`, optional `description` and `actions` (default `read`, `create`, `update`, `delete`); field, primary-key and relation metadata comes from the database. Re-adding a collection with the same actions is a no-op, even with a different title or description: the first registration is kept and startup logs a warning. Different actions throw. Pages are not registered here: the client route that declares `authz: { resource: { type: 'page', id: 'sales.quotes' }, action: 'access' }` is what lists the page in the workspace.

`.grant(key, permission, { title? })` binds a collection permission to a data scope named `key`. Read fields govern output; create and update fields govern input. Use explicit lists, `'*'` or `.allFields()`; delete has no fields. Include fields written by the server, such as timestamps. `.options(...recordAccessReferences)` limits the record access a grant may choose; `.default(reference)` sets the value used when a grant chooses nothing. Omitting options offers every registered record access that applies to the collection.

Use [code versus seeds](code-and-seeds.md) for the engineer permission set and its assignments, and [record access](business-module.md#3-register-record-access) for the preparer and region selections. Page access and business actions are independent; registration alone grants neither.

## Enforce the operation on the server

Every route installs authentication and `authz.middleware()`. For a business action, authorize once and bind every resulting collection policy before executing queries. Validate input and business transitions separately.

router.use('*', authentication.required(), authz.middleware());
router.get('/quotes', async (c) => {

        const policyInput = options.writePolicy === undefined ? true : options.writePolicy;
        assertWriteEnabled(policyInput);
        const writePolicy = policyInput === true ? true : normalizeWritePolicy(policyInput, 'create');
        const collection = await this.collection();

实现者过程与运行背景 · 7 个过程问题 / 4 条建议 · 不自动归为框架问题

本任务已处理只描述应用侧处理结果，不代表 NocoBase3 上游已修复。

本轮过程记录

Repair attempt 3 for issue 496 (内部资料只读问答助手). Fixed the seed module-resolution failure that blocked application startup, the composite-resource registration order that made stored grants invalid, a wildcard API middleware leak, a write read-back permission failure, a missing createdAt/updatedAt on writes, and a test-only CSRF trusted-origin gap. Also completed the assistant wiring: a named read-only employee (materials-desk) and a backend materials-lookup tool that authorizes the same composite resource the page uses, so the consultant's read is narrowed in SQL before a confidential record can reach an answer or citation. B00 is verified end-to-end against the compiled dist server, and the employee/tool registration plus the colleague-vs-supervisor data scope are covered by a new test. B01-B05 remain blocked because no independent business/AI test model is configured (llmServices=0).

问题 01 · install

Database seed imported a TypeScript source through a .js specifier

本任务已处理

AppDatabaseTaskError: Database seeds failed for connection "main": Cannot find module '.../database/seed-data/permission-sets.js' imported from '.../database/main/seeds/202610010002_materials_demo.ts' (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND).

原因（实现者自述）
Node 24 native TypeScript stripping executes the seed without rewriting relative .js specifiers to .ts, so an import that named a TypeScript-only file with a .js extension resolved to a file that does not exist.
处理方式
Import the source with a .ts specifier in database/main/seeds/202610010002_materials_demo.ts and database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts. tsconfig.server.json enables allowImportingTsExtensions and rewriteRelativeImportExtensions, so the compiler emits .js specifiers into dist; verified in dist/database/main/seeds/.manifest.json and the compiled imports.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 02 · boot

Composite resource registered after stored grants were scanned

本任务已处理

Error: Authorization has invalid stored grants: - Permission set materials-colleague grants composite:materials.library.view, which no longer applies: Unknown composite resource action: materials.library.view.

原因（实现者自述）
The application provider registered its composite resource in start(), but the authorization plugin provider's start() scans stored grants before the application's service providers start, so the grant named an action that was not yet registered.
处理方式
Register the composite resource in MaterialsProvider.register() (server/providers/materials.ts), which runs before any provider starts, and guard it with container.has(authorizationToken) so an app assembled without the authorization plugin still boots.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 03 · api

Wildcard middleware in the materials contribution leaked into sibling API routes

本任务已处理

tests/logic/app-server.test.ts 'starts a fresh Default without example tables or APIs' expected 200 for GET /api/articles and received 401.

原因（实现者自述）
router.use('*', authentication.required(), ...) mounted in one API contribution becomes /api/* on the parent router and intercepted every later API contribution, not just the paths the route owns.
处理方式
Scope each guard to the two paths the route owns with router.use('/materials', guard) and router.use('/materials/*', guard), covering the collection and the item routes and nothing else.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 04 · api

Create and update failed a read-back permission check

本任务已处理

A manage grant could write a material but the write then threw READ_FORBIDDEN while re-reading the row it had just touched.

原因（实现者自述）
The Repository re-reads the written record under the same policy, and the materials write permission declared create/update/delete but no read fields.
处理方式
Declare the read fields on the materialsWrite permission in server/materials-resources.ts, because reading a record you may manage is part of managing it.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 05 · db

Material insert failed a NOT NULL constraint on createdAt

本任务已处理

SqliteError: insert into materials ... NOT NULL constraint failed: materials.created_at when the supervisor created a material.

原因（实现者自述）
The collection declares createdAt and updatedAt NOT NULL without a database default, and @nocobase/db has no automatic timestamp behaviour, so a writer that omitted them inserted NULL.
处理方式
The materials route sets createdAt/updatedAt on create and updatedAt on update, and the write permission lists those fields; the seed already supplied them. Mirrors how the notification-in-app plugin writes its own rows.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 06 · test

Cookie-authenticated writes were rejected as INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN in the isolated test server

本任务已处理

tests/logic/app-server.test.ts expected 201 for a supervisor POST and received 403 {"code":"INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN"}.

原因（实现者自述）
The isolated standalone test config set no app.publicOrigin, so better-auth's trusted origins were empty and checkCookieWriteOrigin rejected the write's Origin header.
处理方式
The runtime test config fixture now writes app.publicOrigin and the write requests send a matching Origin header; the production standalone server trusts APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN the same way.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 07 · assistant

No independent business/AI model configured for the assistant criteria

未解决

Server reports llmServices=0; POST /api/ai/ai:listAllEnabledModels returns [], so B01–B05 cannot be exercised.

原因（实现者自述）
The verification environment provides no independent business test model or LLM service credentials.
处理方式
Implemented and verified without a model: server/materials-service.ts authorizes the materials.library composite for a hand-built actor identity and binds the returned policy with repository.withPolicy; server/ai/tools/materials-lookup.ts exposes it as a read-only tool, and server/ai/employees/materials-desk registers a named employee that cites results and refuses to answer without evidence. A new app-server test proves the colleague's tool reads only the two public materials while the supervisor reads all three. B00 is satisfied without a model: the assistant page shows an explicit not-configured notice and the materials page stays usable. B01-B05 stay blocked pending a configured model.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 ·

Resolve TypeScript sources with .ts specifiers in seeds and migrations

需人工判断

Node's native TS stripping does not rewrite .js specifiers to .ts. Any seed or migration that imports an application-owned TypeScript module should use the .ts specifier, and the server tsconfig rewrites it to .js at build time.

建议改动

具体改动未提供

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 ·

Register composite resources before providers start

需人工判断

Authorization scans stored grants in its provider start(), which runs before the application's service providers start. A composite resource must be registered in register()/boot() rather than start() or stored grants are reported invalid.

建议改动

具体改动未提供

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 03 ·

Never use router.use('*') in an API contribution

需人工判断

A wildcard use() in one contribution becomes /api/* on the parent and intercepts sibling contributions. Scope middleware to the exact paths the route owns.

建议改动

具体改动未提供

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 04 ·

An out-of-band AI tool must authorize like the HTTP path

需人工判断

A tool call has no request, so no authz middleware runs. Build the actor identity explicitly (principal plus authenticated:* plus resolved memberships), authorize the same composite resource the page uses, and bind the resulting database policy with repository.withPolicy - never hand a tool an unscoped Repository.

建议改动

具体改动未提供

来源：Agent · retro.json

做得好的地方
F5 · 框架随包提供 nocobase-ai 对话前端与多信号就绪门禁

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-ai-employee

⌄

app-plugin-ai-employee 的 registry/nocobase-ai 是可直接安装的前端对话表面，Provider 暴露 configurationStatus/configurationError/modelConfigurationError/hasEnabledModels 四个独立信号，并用 UNCONFIGURED_MODEL 占位；chat-surfaces.md 的 readiness gate 说明如何据此降级。应用无需手写对话 UI 即获得“未配置模型”的明确状态。

提供的帮助
显著降低资料助手前端的实现与验收成本，并让“未配置”成为框架级的一等状态而非业务补丁。
应保留的能力
保持该 Registry 表面的公开契约稳定，并在 Skill 中补充多信号优先级的判定顺序示例。
E4 E5
做得好的地方
F6 · AI 工具上下文隔离与授权策略在数据层强制的组合

NocoBase3 内核 · @nocobase/ai-employee · @nocobase/app-plugin-authorization

⌄

ai-employee 为每个工具解析其声明的依赖并返回独立上下文，工具无法访问未声明的容器内容；authorization 的复合资源/记录范围与 db 的策略回读共同保证行级可见性在仓储层生效，而不是依赖前端过滤。两者结合使“资料助手只能看到有权资料”具备可审计的实现基础。

提供的帮助
降低了提示词或前端疏漏导致越权读取保密资料的风险，并为引用回链提供可信的可见性边界。
应保留的能力
继续在 Skill 中以端到端示例展示工具 actor 与行级策略的配合，减少 Agent 自行拼接的出错空间。

/**
 * The context one tool runs with: the call's own context, plus the container
 * dependencies that tool declared. Each tool gets its own, so a tool can reach
 * neither what another tool declared nor anything undeclared.
 */
export function createToolContext(entity, base, container) {
    const declared = entity.dependencies ?? {};
    const names = Object.keys(declared);
    if (!base || typeof base !== 'object') {
        if (names.length)
            throw new Error(`Tool "${entity.definition.name}" declares dependencies but this agent has no tool context to resolve them into`);
        return base;
    }
    const deps = {};
    for (const name of names) {
        const token=[REDACTED]        if (!container)
            throw new Error(`Tool "${entity.definition.name}" declares dependency "${name}" but this agent has no container to resolve it from`);
        try {
            deps[name] = container.resolve(token);
        }
        catch (error) {
            throw new Error(`Tool "${entity.definition.name}" declares dependency "${name}" ("${token.name}") which the application container cannot resolve`, { cause: error });
        }
    }
    return { ...base, deps };
}

/** Explicit lifecycle contract for application-owned AI resources. */
export class AIResourceRegistrar {
    logger;
    skillsDirectories;
    constructor(options = {}) {
        this.logger = options.logger;
        this.skillsDirectories = normalizeDirectories(options.skillsDirectories ?? [], options.source ?? 'application');
    }
    async registerAIResources(ai) {
        await this.registerTools(ai.toolsManager);
        this.logStage('tools', await ai.toolsManager.listTools({}));
        await this.loadSkills(ai);
        this.logStage('skills', await ai.skillsManager.listSkills());
        await this.registerAIEmployees(ai.employeeManager);
        this.logStage('employees', await ai.employeeManager.listEmployees());
    }
    async loadSkills(ai) {
        for (const { directory, source, optional } of this.skillsDirectories) {
            if (!fs.existsSync(directory)) {
                this.logger?.[optional ? 'debug' : 'warn']?.({ directory, source, stage: 'skills' }, 'AI Skill directory does not exist; skipping');
                continue;
            }
            await new SkillsLoader(ai, {
                scan: {
                    basePath: directory,
                    pattern: ['**/SKILL.md'],
                },
                logger: this.logger,
            }).load();
            this.logger?.debug?.({ directory, source, stage: 'skills' }, 'AI Skill directory loaded');
        }
    }
    logStage(stage, resources) {
        this.logger?.debug?.({ total: resources.length, stage }, `AI ${stage} registration completed`);
    }
}

## The readiness gate

`NocoBaseAIRootProvider` starts employee and model discovery asynchronously and does **not** defer mounting its children. A chat initialized before discovery finishes shows fallback defaults while its internal selection and transport still reflect an empty configuration, and the first send fails or silently uses nothing. A loading overlay over an already-mounted chat does not fix this, because the chat has already initialized underneath it.

So gate the whole `AIChatProvider` subtree from a child component that reads `useAI()` under the root, and check the three signals separately — `configurationStatus` can be `'ready'` while model discovery failed, and `models` can hold a `configured: false` placeholder, so neither status nor array length alone proves the chat can send.

/** Package-internal: the reserved type every composite is stored under. */
export const COMPOSITE_RESOURCE_TYPE = 'composite';
export class CompositeResourceActionBuilder {
    data;
    constructor(data = { grants: [], dataScopes: [] }) {
        this.data = structuredClone(data);
    }
    title(title) {
        return new CompositeResourceActionBuilder({ ...this.data, title });
    }
    grant(valueOrKey, permission, metadata) {
        const contribution = typeof valueOrKey === 'string'
            ? permission?.bind(valueOrKey, metadata)
            : valueOrKey;
        if (!contribution)
            throw new TypeError('A permission is required');
        const built = contribution.build();
        const dataScopes = [...this.data.dataScopes];
        for (const scope of built.dataScopes ?? []) {
            if (dataScopes.some((entry) => entry.key === scope.key))
                throw new TypeError(`Duplicate data scope: ${scope.key}`);
            dataScopes.push(scope);
        }
        return new CompositeResourceActionBuilder({
            ...this.data,
            grants: [...this.data.grants, ...built.grants],
            dataScopes,
        });
    }
    build() {
        return structuredClone(this.data);
    }
}

export function composeDatabasePolicies(checks) {
    const policies = Object.create(null);
    for (const check of checks) {
        if (check.resource.type !== 'database.collection')
            continue;
        const policy = (policies[check.resource.id] ??= {
            read: false,
            create: false,
            update: false,
            delete: false,
        });
        switch (check.action) {
            case 'read':
                policy.read = foldDecision('read', check.decision);
                break;
            case 'create':
                policy.create = foldDecision('create', check.decision);
                break;
            case 'update':
                policy.update = foldDecision('update', check.decision);
                break;
            case 'delete':
                policy.delete = foldDecision('delete', check.decision);
                break;
        }
    }
    return policies;
}

Every collection a business action touches must be registered, including for unrestricted users. Registration carries `name`, `title`, optional `description` and `actions` (default `read`, `create`, `update`, `delete`); field, primary-key and relation metadata comes from the database. Re-adding a collection with the same actions is a no-op, even with a different title or description: the first registration is kept and startup logs a warning. Different actions throw. Pages are not registered here: the client route that declares `authz: { resource: { type: 'page', id: 'sales.quotes' }, action: 'access' }` is what lists the page in the workspace.

`.grant(key, permission, { title? })` binds a collection permission to a data scope named `key`. Read fields govern output; create and update fields govern input. Use explicit lists, `'*'` or `.allFields()`; delete has no fields. Include fields written by the server, such as timestamps. `.options(...recordAccessReferences)` limits the record access a grant may choose; `.default(reference)` sets the value used when a grant chooses nothing. Omitting options offers every registered record access that applies to the collection.

Use [code versus seeds](code-and-seeds.md) for the engineer permission set and its assignments, and [record access](business-module.md#3-register-record-access) for the preparer and region selections. Page access and business actions are independent; registration alone grants neither.

## A normal App seed has a database context

`defineSeed` from `@nocobase/db` receives `{ query, connection }`. `connection` is a restricted `SeedConnection`, not a complete runtime `DatabaseConnection`; the seed has no application container. Do not cast it to construct an App authorization service or assume `authorizationToken` can be resolved there.

For initial installation, a seed may write the documented persistence rows below after the owning plugins' migrations. Keep this adapter confined to installation data, use fluent values as its input, and test against the installed schema. Runtime routes must use the services instead. Keep one seed-data module per table.

```ts
import { defineSeed } from '@nocobase/db';
import { encodeAuthorizationTitle } from '@nocobase/authorization/core';
import { engineer } from '../../seed-data/permission-sets.js';

export default defineSeed({
  name: '202609190001_sales_jobs',
  transaction: true,
  async run({ query }) {
    const existing = await query
      .selectFrom('authorizationPermissionSets')
      .select('id')
      .where('key', '=', engineer.key)
      .executeTakeFirst();
    if (existing) return; // Preserve an administrator's existing definition.
    const now = new Date();
    await query
      .insertInto('authorizationPermissionSets')
      .values({
        id: engineer.key,
        key: engineer.key,
        title: encodeAuthorizationTitle(engineer.title),
        grants: JSON.stringify(engineer.grants),
        createdAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
      })
      .execute();
  },
});
```

This seed lives in `database/main/seeds/202609190001_sales_jobs.ts` and imports `database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts`. Adapt the path to the App's configured seed directory; the seed name matches the filename. Ensure schema migrations for authorization and business collections have run, and explicitly order prerequisite installation data. Use the App's existing migration/seed commands. Do not run this code in a migration: migrations must describe fixed schema history and cannot import live business declarations.

            await middleware.register(this.router, this);
        }
        for (const routes of this.routes) {
            const router = await routes.createRouter(this);
            this.router.route(routes.scope === 'api' ? '/api' : '/', router);
        }
        this.routesRegistered = true;
    }

E21 · packages/@nocobase/app-server/dist/router/routes.js:7–18

defineApiRoutes 与 defineRootRoutes 以 scope=api/root 冻结路由定义，应用服务器据此把业务 API 与根路由分区挂载。

export function defineApiRoutes(createRouter) {
    return Object.freeze({
        scope: 'api',
        createRouter,
    });
}
export function defineRootRoutes(createRouter) {
    return Object.freeze({
        scope: 'root',
        createRouter,
    });
}

server-routes.md 明确警告“A router.use('*', ...) on the top-level router leaks into contributions mounted later”，并把中间件限定到自有路径或独立子路由器。

Keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and its static policies. For business authorization, follow the installed authorization Skill’s `references/repository-routes.md`: `authz.database.authorizeRepository({ repository, resource, actions })` binds Repository methods to typed business actions and narrows the existing policy through middleware. Authenticate first and cover every action of the protected exposure. Use the shortcut when one Repository operation and one data scope complete the action with standard input/output; independent type/length validation can remain middleware. Persisted-state checks, side effects, multiple scopes and enriched responses require custom handlers: project title/notes editing fits the shortcut, while draft quote editing, quote submission and order delivery do not. One resource can use both styles for different actions. Do not substitute collection-aggregated grants for a business-action decision.

Static endpoint policies only narrow user grants. Read/write relation capabilities must be explicitly granted; a relation in the static shape does not create permission. Use the authorization Skill's `references/business-module.md` for the full workflow and `references/fluent-registration.md` for field/relation declarations. The installable authorization example demonstrates quote submission and delivery responsibilities.

## Scope middleware to paths you own

Use the explicit path, or an isolated sub-router mounted at your prefix as above. A `router.use('*', ...)` on the top-level router leaks into contributions mounted later and is the way an unrelated endpoint accidentally becomes protected — or, worse, the way yours accidentally is not.

## Deliberately public routes

A third-party webhook cannot present a login session, so it is public by design. Public still requires a security boundary:

E54 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/repository-routes.md:166–172

repository-routes.md 的“Enforcement and limits”称 “Using '*' is appropriate inside an isolated, owned router: the middleware ignores other repository names”，与 server-routes.md 对顶层 router.use('*') 泄漏的警告形成对照。

## Enforcement and limits

- Mount the middleware on every action of the named exposure. Using `'*'` is appropriate inside an isolated, owned router: the middleware ignores other repository names. A method of its repository with no mapping is denied, including methods added to the generated route later.
- The middleware reuses the request's existing authorization context or initializes one. Authentication is still the owning route's responsibility.
- Each bound action must declare exactly one data scope, compose grants on that collection only and contain the mapped CRUD operation. Multi-collection or same-collection multi-scope actions are rejected at integration time. Resource registration must precede router creation.
- One composite can be bound to several Repository exposures through separate middleware instances. Each mapping is checked at the action level. An exposure's actual collection and database connection must match the request constraint; this adapter currently supports the default connection only.
- Keep actions requiring workflow state, cross-record relationships, or side effects in custom handlers. Single-scope authorization does not prove that an operation needs no business validation. Quote editing/submission and delivery remain custom in the sales workflow.

  4. 在 Settings > User management 确认存在隔离账号 资料同事 @colleague 与 资料主管 @supervisor 及其专属权限集
  5. 通过 User actions > Reset password 分别为 colleague 与 supervisor 设置已知测试密码
  6. 退出管理员，以主管账号 supervisor 登录并完整重新加载应用，打开 Materials 页面
  7. supervisor 打开资料 B 编辑弹窗，核对原值回填（Title=蓝鹭设备巡检周期，Body=…45 天…），修改正文并点击 Save 实际提交，随后刷新确认持久化
  8. 退出登录，以普通同事账号 colleague 登录并完整重新加载应用，打开 Materials 页面
  9. 在页面内用 fetch 直接请求 /main/api/materials、/main/api/materials/1、/main/api/materials/2、/main/api/materials/3、/main/api/materials?filterByTk=3
  10. 直接打开 /main/materials/3 尝试访问 C 的页面；刷新 Materials 页面确认资料仍保存
  11. 打开 Materials assistant 页面查看未配置模型时的助手状态，并检查网络请求与控制台错误
  12. 验收完成前以 supervisor 身份把资料 B 正文恢复为原始 45 天并刷新确认，保持样例基线

  1. 管理员与主管的 Materials 页面均显示三条资料：蓝鹭设备报修方式(Public，蓝鹭设备报修电话为 400-000-7316…)、蓝鹭设备巡检周期(Public，原为…45 天…)、保密项目内部代号(Confidential，保密项目的内部代号为墨竹 729，仅主管及以上人员可查阅)
  2. LLM services 页显示 No LLM services configured，本轮无可用业务模型
  3. User management 显示 资料主管 @supervisor · materials.supervisor@example.com (materials.permissionSet.supervisor) 与 资料同事 @colleague · materials.colleague@example.com (materials.permissionSet.colleague) 两个隔离账号；已通过管理员 UI 为两者分别重置密码
  4. supervisor 打开资料 B 编辑弹窗时原值正确回填（标题与正文均与列表一致），修改正文点 Save 后列表即时显示新内容；刷新后内容仍在（持久化）
  5. 普通同事 colleague 的 Materials 页面仅显示 蓝鹭设备报修方式 与 蓝鹭设备巡检周期 两条 Public 资料，无 保密项目内部代号，无 New/Edit/Delete 入口，页面提示 You can read the public materials. Confidential records stay hidden.
  6. 同事直接读取：GET /main/api/materials/3 返回 404 {code:NOT_FOUND}，GET /main/api/materials/1 与 /2 返回 200；列表接口 /main/api/materials 仅返回 2 条（id 1、2，meta.canManage=false），/main/api/materials?filterByTk=3 也只返回 2 条，C 无法被直接读取
  7. 直接打开 /main/materials/3 被重定向回 /main，普通同事无法访问 C 的页面
  8. 同事刷新 Materials 页面后仍只见 A/B，两条资料内容完整保存（刷新持久化）
  9. 管理员与同事的 Materials assistant 页面均显示 No AI model is configured / No enabled AI models were returned by NocoBase，并提示 You can still read the materials page，页面无输入框；资料页可正常打开使用
  10. 网络请求中仅有预期的 /main/api/materials/3 返回 404，无其它未处理 4xx/5xx，控制台无 Something went wrong 或未处理异常
  11. 验收收尾已把资料 B 正文恢复为原始 蓝鹭设备常规巡检间隔为 45 天，巡检记录需留档备查。 并刷新确认
